confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live prices or listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence; July hostel and hotel rates are least certain. USD values were set from local GEL examples at a rough general-knowledge rate, not a live one. Cocktail and wine are partly set from the local price relationship to draft beer (cocktail about twice a beer, wine close to a beer), as direct knowledge is weak. FX is second-hand: taken from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the page was not opened and a follow-up search could not reproduce the 15 October figure, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Region set to Europe: Georgia is a Council of Europe member and its traveller price profile sits closer to Eastern European and Balkan capitals than to the Middle East. Price level judged against capitals such as Sofia and Belgrade.
